name: bdrhapsody_targeted_panel
description: BD Rhapsody targeted single-cell transcript panel data.

halt_guidance.blocker: BD Rhapsody targeted panels require the exact panel definition, any custom-primer targets, and vendor barcode/reference resources; a whole-transcriptome STARsolo matrix would be incomplete and misleading.
required_inputs: Exact BD Rhapsody targeted panel name, catalog number, and version
Complete targeted gene/transcript list plus every supplemental custom-primer sequence
BD Rhapsody cartridge/chemistry version and matching barcode/reference archive
Sample-tag, multiplexing, AbSeq, or other feature-barcode definitions when used
Reference FASTA/GTF and BD pipeline configuration matching the deposited experiment
next_steps: Recover the panel manifest and custom-primer target list from the experiment records or submitter.
Match the cartridge, barcode reference, genome reference, sample tags, and optional AbSeq resources to the deposited FASTQs.
Run the FASTQs with the BD Rhapsody Targeted Analysis Pipeline and preserve the complete configuration and software version.
Validate cell barcodes, target identities, target-level counts, and sample-tag demultiplexing before downstream analysis.

recommended_workflows.name: BD Rhapsody Targeted Analysis Pipeline
recommended_workflows.role: BD-supported barcode processing and cell-by-target matrix generation

halt_guidance.resume: Use the validated vendor cell-by-target matrix downstream and label it as targeted transcriptomics; do not present it as a whole-transcriptome GEX matrix.
